subject: Vendor registration stuck at 'Finalize Purchase Info' — session drop during login
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@slatebridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, procureops@slatebridge.com
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration failing at final step

Hi Grace,

We're trying to finish our vendor registration in your supplier portal (Coupa link we received from Procurement) but every time we click through to 'Finalize Purchase Info' the page briefly shows the confirmation spinner and then dumps us back to the login screen. No error message, no SAML page — it just looks like our session expires mid-flow.

We need to submit a PO this afternoon and are blocked. I attached a couple of screenshots and a short screen capture (zipped) showing the sequence.

What we've tried: Chrome 118 on macOS 11.6 (company-managed), cleared cache, incognito mode, different network (office VPN vs home). Same behavior.

Any quick suggestions? If you need a HAR or additional logs we can capture those.

Thanks,
Sara Li
Procurement Ops
SlateBridge Logistics

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note and the screenshots. Sorry you're blocked — we'll get this sorted.

Quick triage items so we can narrow the cause:
- Can you confirm whether you hit the portal from the tenant-specific link (tenant.supplier.redwood.com) or the shared /invite link?
- If possible, grab a HAR while reproducing and attach it (we're particularly interested in the redirect chain to /po/confirm).
- Does your SSO provider show any errors for the times below? If so, a SAMLResponse or request id helps.

Monica, can you take ownership of a live session with SlateBridge if they can do a quick screenshare? Ben — FYI on potential PO manual flow if they need to submit before we fully remediate. Rafael — can you check the gateway cookies for SameSite/expiry changes this morning?

Sara — while we investigate, two short workarounds: 1) use the tenant direct URL and avoid the intermediate /invite redirect; 2) if you can send the PO details to procureops@redwood.com we can submit on your behalf (manual intake).

I'll follow up once we have more details.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration failing at final step

Hi Sara — quick update after reviewing your HAR and our gateway logs. We reproduced the flow in-house and identified the root cause: when the invite link routes through our shared redirector the session cookie is set with SameSite=Lax and the subsequent cross-path POST to /po/confirm is treated as a cross-site navigation by Chrome (Chrome 118 tightened handling for POST+redirects). The portal then issues an immediate redirect to /login because the auth cookie isn't sent on that particular handoff.

What we changed/why it affected you: last week we rolled a small proxy change to normalize the /invite -> /tenant redirect for analytics. That proxy does not preserve the cookie attributes the tenant endpoint expects. On tenant direct link the cookie is preserved and the flow may succeed (as you saw once).

Workarounds we can offer immediately:
- Use the tenant direct URL (tenant.slatebridge.supplier.redwood.com/accept?token=...) — this should avoid the proxy handshake that strips the cookie.
- I attached a sanitized PO template (po_template_v2.xlsx) you can use to email procureops@redwood.com; we'll intake and submit for you while we push a fix.

Planned fix: Rafael will deploy a small proxy adjustment that preserves SameSite=None and Secure attributes on the redirect response. We expect a hotfix in the next 6–8 hours, after which we will ask you to retry the invite link end-to-end. Rafael, please confirm ETA.

If you can do a 30-min screenshare this afternoon I can walk through the tenant link and confirm success.

Thanks for the clear HAR and video — that made the triage much faster.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding — Redwood Inference
